phases.notes: Created authRoutes.ts wiring register/login (with validate middleware) and me (with requireJwt middleware). Mounted at /api/auth in app.ts. Added JWT_SECRET=test-jwt-secret to vitest.config.ts env so the service can sign tokens during tests. All 34 tests pass; build clean.
